newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: MEDIENOS PLAUSHAS Q1 97 PROFIT UP SLIGHTLY.
newsitem.headline: MEDIENOS PLAUSHAS Q1 97 PROFIT UP SLIGHTLY.

text.p: Lithuanian cardboard and packaging producer Medienos Plaushas said its profit advanced slightly to 1.2 million litas during the first quarter of 1997 versus 1.1 million litas the same period last year.

"We saw our profit rise to 1.2 million litas during the three months of this year versus 1.1 million litas within the same period a year ago," production director of the company, Viktoras Gritkus, told Reuters.
"Our production sales also rose in the first quarter of this year to 10.8 million litas from 9.6 million litas during the first quarter in 1996," Gritkus added.
The company sells 60 percent of its production on the local market, 19 percent to Estonia and Latvia, 12.7 percent to western Europe and 7.4 percent to CIS countries, Gritkus said.
Medienos Plaushas and Rokishkis Cheese were the only two companies included on the official trading list of Vilnius bourse this week.
The list also includes Vilniaus and Hermis bank.
